item.summary: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, chaired the 240th meeting of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT), Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) in New Delhi today. Co-Vice-Chairperson Dr. Chandra Bhushan Kumar (Secretary, Labour & Employment), and Member Secretary Shri Ramesh Krishnamurthi (CPFC), alongside representatives of Central/State…
